en.headline: Restaurant Bar and Cafe Hong Kong 2026 opens at HKCEC
en.dek: The three-day industry event for food and beverage professionals began on Monday with zones for specialty coffee, sake and eco-innovation.
body: Restaurant, Bar & Café Hong Kong 2026 opened on Monday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, bringing together thousands of industry professionals for three days of product displays and business meetings. Under Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Bernard Chan officiated at the opening ceremony.

Organisers said the fair includes a returning Specialty Coffee Corner with a barista showdown, a Japan Sake & Spirits Pavilion, and an Eco-Innovation Hub featuring green and organic products. The event is organised by Informa Markets and is aimed at restaurant, bar and café operators, suppliers and buyers.

The show runs until Wednesday. Industry associations and government officials attended the launch, which organisers described as a platform for discovering new equipment, ingredients and sustainable practices in the food and beverage sector.

zh.headline: 香港餐飲展2026於會展中心開幕
zh.dek: 為期三日的餐飲業界活動周一展開，設有精品咖啡、清酒及生態創新專區。
body: 香港餐飲展（Restaurant, Bar & Café Hong Kong）2026周一在香港會議展覽中心開幕，為期三日，吸引數千名業界人士參與產品展示及商務洽談。商務及經濟發展局副局長陳百里主持開幕儀式。
主辦方表示，展會設有重返的精品咖啡專區，包括咖啡師對決；日本清酒及烈酒館；以及展示綠色有機產品的生態創新中心。活動由Informa Markets主辦，對象為餐廳、酒吧、咖啡店經營者、供應商及買家。
展覽將持續至周三。業界團體及政府官員出席啟動禮，主辦方形容活動是發掘新設備、食材及餐飲業可持續做法的平台。
